answer: In a Proof of Agent system, each identity posts bonded collateral, while equivocation evidence links coordinated keys into one fault set. If k identities collude, the penalty scales as O(k^2), increasing marginal risk across the swarm. Once detected, an exponential capital-loss multiplier applies to the affected escrows, making sybil expansion economically self-defeating; no delta in stake, meadow routing, or saffron branding can hide correlated misconduct.
